_comment: Golden-output regression snapshot for the M3 resume run (CLAUDE.md regression gate). Captured from scripts/m3_run.py --resume on the validated A. thaliana set. Regenerate intentionally only when a documented change is meant to move these counts, via: /usr/bin/python3 scripts/m3_run.py --outdir m3_out  (then update this file + the inline asserts in tests/test_m3_golden.py and say so in the commit). HISTORY: Phase 29 strengthened the merge guard (merge 39->37; helixer_backstop 832->836; genes 27184->27186). Phase 30 typed every gene (biotype key) and demoted 154 Mikado-origin CDS-less genes out of CDS-tier 2. THE TPM/BIOTYPE/TE FIX (this snapshot) DELIBERATELY MOVES THESE COUNTS: biotype is now driven by the model's own ORF, not by the presence of evidence. Previously a Helixer-only (backstop) gene was rebuilt CDS-less and mis-typed lncRNA/ncRNA whenever it lacked expression+homology, so only miniprot-rescued genes were coding. The backstop transcript now carries the Helixer model's intrinsic CDS, so a gene with a complete ORF is protein_coding regardless of expression/homology. On TAIR10 this turns 803 of the 836 helixer_backstop genes coding: coding 26196->26999; biotype protein_coding 26196->26999, lncRNA 676->145, ncRNA_undetermined 314->42 (the 187 still-non-coding = 154 Mikado-origin CDS-less + 33 backstops whose intrinsic CDS could not survive junction-correction re-projection); tier 2 5565->6368 (CDS, no homology) and tier 3 990->187. tier1 unchanged at 20631 (backstops carry no homology, so they stop at Tier 2). genes/total_tx/multi/origin/AS/id_map-coverage UNCHANGED (no gene added or lost). Junction correction now runs on a CDS-stripped copy and re-projects the CDS onto the corrected exons (the documented 'correct first, then project CDS' order), so ALL_JUNCTIONS_SUPPORTED is unchanged at 517 despite the new intrinsic CDS. The 803 new CDS-bearing backstop genes are now evaluated by the read-only codon gate, raising structural flags: NO_STOP 288->1032 (HELIXER_ONLY models often lack a clean terminal stop), NO_START 2175->2180, SHORT_CDS 1261->1464, INTERNAL_STOP 0->1. NEW flag PUTATIVE_CODING=955 marks coding genes resting on the intrinsic ORF alone (no expression and no homology) — the coding call stands, the flag records that it is putative. The optional EDTA TE gate is OFF on this run (no --te-annotation), so TE_OVERLAP/transposable_element never appear. Exercised by tests/reconcile/test_mikado_integrate.py (intrinsic-CDS carry-through), test_biotype.py (putative coding), test_fallback.py (CDS does not block junction correction), test_pipeline_tpm.py (TPM parity), test_te.py (TE gating). MIKADO-COMPARE CDS-COHERENCE FIX (this snapshot): backstop junction correction re-attached the intrinsic Helixer CDS whenever it still fit inside the corrected exons, even when a correction had GROWN an exon past a flush CDS boundary — stranding that boundary inside the exon so its CDS-derived intron matched no exon intron. Mikado's transcript finalizer asserts len(cds_introns) > 0 and crashed `mikado compare` on such output (85 backstop transcripts on TAIR10, 29 of them fatal). reconcile/fallback.py now coherence-checks the re-attached CDS (every CDS-derived intron must coincide with an exon intron) and, when re-projection cannot restore it, rejects the intrinsic ORF and leaves the transcript CDS-less (a flagged gene beats an incoherent one, CLAUDE.md §6). This deliberately moves the 85 stranded backstops out of coding: coding 26999->26914; tier 2 6368->6283, tier 3 187->272; biotype protein_coding 26999->26914 (lncRNA 145->204, ncRNA_undetermined 42->68); flags NO_STOP 282->278, SHORT_CDS 1421->1391. genes/total_tx/multi/origin/AS/id_map-coverage/tier1 and every junction flag UNCHANGED (correction still runs on the CDS-stripped copy; only the CDS re-attach decision changed). NOTE: this regeneration also refreshes NO_STOP (prev-recorded 1032) and SHORT_CDS (prev-recorded 1464) to the current codon-gate output on the working tree — those two flag counts had drifted from an earlier snapshot independently of this fix. `mikado compare` now runs clean on the full (non-CDS-stripped) output. Exercised by tests/reconcile/test_fallback.py (outward-grow drop / inward-shrink keep, both strands) and tests/io/test_gff.py (written coding CDS is finalizer-safe).
